title: Manage Beacon Favourites
steps: Open GIS and add the Beacons layer.
Select the star control beside a visible beacon to add it to Favourites.
Select Favourites to view the added beacon.
Select the beacon's star control again to remove it from Favourites.
Confirm that Favourites shows no favourite beacons.
reason: Add instructions for adding a visible beacon to Favourites, finding it there, and removing it again.
